posts.title: FDA Approves Rinvoq for Nonsegmental Vitiligo, Expanding Treatment Options
posts.description: As reported on FiercePharma, the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) has approved Rinvoq (upadacitinib) for the treatment of nonsegmental vitiligo (NSV) in adults and adolescents aged 12 years and older, giving patients access to the first systemic therapy authorized for the condition in the United States. The approval represents the 10th FDA indication for […]

posts.title: Stem Cell Gene Therapy for Cystinosis
posts.description: Cystinosis is a rare inherited condition caused by changes in the CTNS gene. Without working cystinosin, a substance called cystine builds up inside cells and can gradually damage many parts of the body.
